points.headline: Own the export failures before they raise them
points.detail: Large CSV exports time out and scheduled exports fail silently since v2.4. Rohan said it is blocking their month-end close.

points.headline: We missed the scheduled exports promise
points.detail: Scheduled exports were committed at the Q3 review and the date has passed. Say so plainly.

points.headline: Ask how finance is closing the month today
points.detail: Finance usage fell the most and Priya says they reconcile by hand. Learn the cost and what would unblock them first.

points.headline: Commit to a fix date tied to the export hotfix
points.detail: The export pagination fix is in progress but late. Give a date you can keep and offer a status update until it ships.

points.headline: Book the finance onboarding session
points.detail: The dedicated finance onboarding is still open from the last review. Propose times in this meeting.

points.headline: Usage drop and a weak health score ahead of renewal
points.detail: Usage is down sharply since v2.4 and health is 54. A second missed date would put the renewal at risk.

hypotheses.title: The v2.4 export pipeline broke large and scheduled exports
hypotheses.explanation: v2.4 replaced the export pipeline right before the drop, export usage fell about 71%, and three open tickets describe export timeouts, silent failures and a missing column.
hypotheses.howToConfirm: Compare export error and timeout rates for Acme before and after v2.4.

hypotheses.title: Finance stopped using the product for month-end work
hypotheses.explanation: Finance usage fell about 62%, and Acme says finance is reconciling by hand because scheduled exports stopped arriving.
hypotheses.howToConfirm: Ask Priya whether finance moved month-end reporting to spreadsheets.

hypotheses.title: Seat cleanup reduced the number of active users
hypotheses.explanation: A billing ticket questions the seat count, so fewer active seats could explain a small part of the drop.
hypotheses.howToConfirm: Compare active seats this month with the last invoice.
